chapter.verse: Tu-in John' sangin Jesu tungtawnin nungzui a suak leh a kibaptize tamzaw cih thu Pharisee-te in za khin ahihlam Jesu in a theih ciangin
(a taktak, baptizena a pia pen Jesu hilo-in ama' nungzuite hizaw ahih hangin)
Judea gam nusia-in Galilee gam ah paikik hi.
Samaria gam a nawk kul ahih manin
Jacob in a tapa Joseph a piak leitang gei-a om, Sychar a kici Samaria khua khat tung hi.
Tua lai-ah Jacob' tuikhuk om a, Jesu zong khualzin lampaina hangin gim ahih manin tuikhuk gei ah tu-in tawlnga hi. A hun pen sunkim nai sawmlenih pawl ahi hi.
Samaria numei khat tuitawi dingin hong pai hi. Jesu in, “Tui hong suah in,” ci hi.
(A hang pen a nungzuite an lei dingin khuapi lam paikhia khin uh ahih man hi.)
Samaria numeinu in, “Nang Jew mi ahi kimlai kei Samaria numei khat' kiangah tui nong nget a koici dan ahi hiam?” ci hi. (A hang pen Jew mite in Samaria mite tawh bangmah vaihawmkhawm lo uh hi.)
Jesu in, “Pasian' deihguat thupha ahi zongin, ‘Tui hong suah in,’ hong cipa ahi zongin, thei hilehcin ama' kiangah na ngenzaw ding a, amah'n zong nuntakna tui hong pia ding hi,” ci hi.
Numei in, “Sya aw, tuitawi nading bangmah na nei kei a, tuikhuk zong thuk hi. Tua nuntakna tui koi tak pan ngah ding na hi hiam?
I pupi Jacob sangin lianzaw na hi hiam? Amah in hih tuikhuk ko hong pia a, amahmah in dawnin a tate leh a ganhingte in zong hi pan mah dawn uh hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Hih tui a dawn khempeuh dangtakkik ding uh a,
ahi zongin ka piak ding tui a dawn khin peuhpeuh dangtakkik ngei nawnlo ding hi. Tua ka piak ding tui pen amau' sungah tuinak khat suak ding a, tawntung nuntakna phulkhia ding hi,” ci hi.
Numeinu in, “Sya aw, ka dangtak nawnloh nading leh hih takah tuitawi ka pai kul nawnloh nadingin tua tui kei hong pia in,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Pai in. Na pasal va sam inla hih takah hong pai un,”ci hi.
Numeinu in, “Pasal ka nei kei hi,” ci hi. Jesu in, “Pasal ka nei kei na cih, hi peuhmah hi.
A hang pen pasal nga na nei ngei khin a, tu-a na ompih pen na pasal hilo hi. Hih na thugen maan hi,” ci hi.
Numeinu in, “Sya aw, nang pen kamsang khat ci-in kong mu hi.
Ka pupite un hih mualtung ah Pasian bia uh hi. No na hih uhleh Pasian biak nading mun Jerusalem hi na ci uh hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in hih bangin gen hi: “Numei aw, hong um in. Hih mualtung ah ahi-a Jerusalem ah ahi zongin Pa na biak loh ding uh hunlenai hong tung kuanta hi.
Note in na theih loh uh na bia uh a, ko ka hih uhleh hotkhiatna pen Jew mite' kiangpan ahih manin ka theih uh a bia ka hi uh hi.
Ahih hangin a bia taktakte in kha leh thumaan thutak tawh Pa a biak hun hong tung ding a, tu-in zong a tung hita hi. A hang pen Pa in amah a bia dingin tua bang mite a zong ahi hi.
Pasian pen kha hi a, amah a bia mite in kha leh thumaan thutak tawh a biak ding uh ahi hi.”
Numeinu in, “Messiah (Khris a kici pen) hong pai ding cih ka thei hi. Amah hong tun ciangin eite' tungah thu khempeuh hong gen ding hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Tu-a nang tawh kiho keimah pen tua na genpa ka hi hi,” ci hi.

Tua lianleh a nungzuite hong tung uh hi. Numei khat tawh Jesu a kiho lamdang sa mahmah uh ahih hangin, “Bang deih na hi hiam?” cih ahi-a “Bang hangin tua numei tawh kiho na hi hiam?” cih ahi zongin dong ngamlo uh hi.
Tua ciangin numeinu a tuibung nusia-in khua sungah ciah a, mite' kiangah,
“Hong pai un. Ka gamtat khempeuh hong gen thei mipa hong en un. Amah Khris ahikha ding hiam?” ci hi.
Amau zong khua pan pusuakin Jesu' kiangah pai uh hi.
Tua kikalin nungzuite in, “Rabbi aw, an ne in,” ci-in Jesu kun uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in, “Note' theih loh nek ding an ka nei hi,” ci hi.
Nungzuite zong khatlekhat kiho uh a, “Mi khatpeuh in nektheih khatpeuh na puak khinzo ahi ding hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Kei hong sawlpa' deihna sep ding leh ama' nasep ka tawntut ding pen keima' an ahi hi.
‘Anlak hun a tun ding kha li kisam lai,’ ci hilo na hi uh hiam? En un, ke'n kong cihin ah khuadak unla anlak hun lua-in lote paak zihziah cih mu ta un.
Anla mipa in thaman ngah a, tawntung nuntakna' ading gah a kaikhawm ahih manin khaituhpa leh anlapa lungdamkhawm thei uh hi.
A hang pen hih mun ah, ‘Khat in khaituh, khat in anla,’ a cih thuciin a maan ahi hi.
Note' gimpih ahilo mun ah anla dingin note kong sawl hi. Midangte in na gimpih khin uh a, note pen amau' gimpihsa a va siim na hi uh hi.”
“Ka gamtat khempeuh amah in hong gen thei hi,” cih numeinu' teci panna hangin tua khua-a Samaria mite tampitak in Jesu um uh hi.
Tua hi a, amaute Jesu' kiangah a tun uh ciangin amau' khua ah Jesu a taam lai nading thum uh hi. Jesu zong tua Samaria mite' khua ah ni nih taam hi.
Ama' thugenna hangin thu-um mi tampi kibehlap hi.
Amaute in numeinu' kiangah, “Nang' genna hangin a um ka hi nawn kei uh hi. A hang pen komaumah in ama' thugen ka za khinzo uh a, amah pen leitung mite' Honpa hi taktak cih ka thei uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Ni nih khit ciangin Galilee pai dingin Jesu dingkhia hi.
(A hang pen Jesu mahmah in kamsang peuhmah a pianna khua ah thupibawlna ngah lo cih a pulak khitsa ahi hi).
Tua hi a, Galilee a tun ciangin Galilee mite in Jerusalem khua pawi hun sunga Jesu' sep teng khempeuh mukha khin uh ahih manin amah na sang uh hi. (Amau zong pawi siimin a pai uh ahi hi.)
Tu-in tui, lengtui a suahsakna Galilee gam Cana khua ah Jesu pai leuleu hi. Capernaum khua ah kumpi ulian khat om a, a tapa cina hi.
Ulianpa in Judea gam pan Galilee gam ah Jesu hong pai cih a zak ciangin ama' kiangah va pai a, Jesu hong paisukin a tapa a damsak nading thum hi. A hang pen a tapa cina gimin a si ding hita hi.
Jesu in ulianpa' kiangah, “Kihilna lim lamdang na muh kei uhleh na um kei ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Ulianpa in, “Sya aw, ka naupangno a sih ma-in hong paisuk in,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Pai in, na tapa nungta ding hi,” ci hi. Ulianpa zong ama' tunga Jesu' gen thu um ahih manin kileh hi.
A paisuk laitak ama' silate in na dawntuah uh a, a tapa a dam ding hita cih thu gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin ulianpa in naupangno noptuam ding a kipat hunlenai a dot leh amaute in, “Zanni sunnung nai khat hunin a cisa kiam hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua pen “Na tapa nungta ding hi,” ci-a ama' kiangah Jesu' gen hunlenai ahihlam a pa in thei hi. Tua ciangin amah-a kipan a innkuanpihte khempeuh in um uh hi.
Hih pen Judea gam pan Galilee gam ah Jesu a tun khit kihilna lim a bawl a nihna ahi hi.
